episodeTitle.en: The rise of taste, human authenticity and judgment in an AI world | Adam Mosseri (Head of IG)
episodeTitle.zh: 在AI世界中品味、人类真实性与判断力的崛起 | 亚当·莫塞里（Instagram负责人）

guestBioOfficial.en: Adam Mosseri is the Head of Instagram, where he oversees an app used by over 3 billion people. He also leads the team building Threads. Adam has run Instagram for longer than its founders did, after taking over from Kevin Systrom and Mike Krieger in 2018. A designer by training, he spent over 15 years at Meta, starting as a designer on Facebook’s mobile app, rising to lead Facebook’s News Feed, and eventually chosen to lead Instagram. During his tenure, Instagram’s user base has more than tripled. *In our in-depth conversation, we discuss:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 亚当·莫塞里是Instagram的负责人，管理着一个拥有30亿以上用户的应用程序。他还领导着Threads团队的建设。亚当接手Instagram的时间比创始人更长，自2018年接替凯文·西斯特罗姆和迈克·克里格尔后掌管Instagram。作为训练有素的设计师，他在Meta工作了15余年，最初在Facebook移动应用担任设计师，随后负责Facebook新闻推送，最终被选中领导Instagram。在他的任期内，Instagram的用户基础增长了两倍多。在我们的深度对话中，我们讨论了：

title.en: The rise of taste, human authenticity and judgment in an AI world | Adam Mosseri (Head of IG)
title.zh: 在AI世界中品味、人类真实性与判断力的崛起 | 亚当·莫塞里（Instagram负责人）

summary.en: Adam argues that taste matters more than ever in an AI world where building is cheap, and that the most valuable people will be clear-eyed about what AI is and isn't good at. He explains that the Instagram algorithm understands users far less semantically than people assume, and predicts AI-generated content will ultimately be a tailwind as people seek out authenticity. He also discusses why human judgment remains essential in the product development lifecycle even as AI eats more of it.
summary.zh: Adam 认为，在 AI 让“造东西”变得廉价的时代，品味比以往任何时候都更重要，而最有价值的人是对 AI 擅长与不擅长之处有清醒认知的人。他解释道，Instagram 算法对用户兴趣的理解远比人们想象的更“非语义化”，并预测 AI 生成内容最终会是顺风，因为人们会更渴望真实。他还讨论了为何即便 AI 吞噬更多产品开发环节，人类判断依然不可或缺。
